title: ci(docker): publish an on-demand public framework build base image
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-zhuang"} -->
_Requested by **Sam** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01GsBogozeZG5sdpAARrN7HP?thread=cmsg_01GsBogozeZG5sdpAARrN7HP1HcuuzFq3zR8mqTyyMaHCW)_
Part of #31441. This PR adds the workflow and the image definition. The card's other half stays open after merge: the first dispatch for a named commit on `main`, setting the new package Public once (GitHub creates a container package private), and the digest and build time read from that run.

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**:新增 `framework-build-base.yml` 和 `docker/framework-build-base/`:按需把 main 上某个框架提交打成公开镜像 `ghcr.io/objectstack-ai/framework-build-base:SHA`,里面是装好依赖、建好全部包和 console 的框架源码树 `/repo/objectstack`。
- **为什么改**:cloud 三个 Dockerfile 现在每次冷缓存或升 pin 都在私有仓计费分钟里从头建框架;这个镜像在公开仓(免费分钟)建一次,cloud 卡 11b(cloud#3792)再改成 `FROM` 它。
- **风险与回滚**:只新增文件,不碰现有 workflow 和运行时镜像;镜像公开,所以构建上下文排除 `.git`、checkout 不留凭据、检查脚本断言镜像里没有 `.git`。回滚 = revert 本 PR,已推的标签留在 ghcr 不影响任何东西。
- **先看**:`.github/workflows/framework-build-base.yml` 的 `publish` 任务(只认 main 上的提交、标签已存在就不重建、匿名读回);`docker/framework-build-base/Dockerfile` 的两个 RUN(参数与 cloud Dockerfile 框架阶段逐项相同);`check-image.sh`。
- **两分钟验证**:打开本 PR 的 `Framework Build Base Image` 检查,作业摘要里有 dry run 的构建耗时和镜像读数(node/pnpm 版本、console 构建标识、镜像大小),什么都没推。
- **需要你做的**:审批本 PR(`.github/workflows/**` 是 Tier H 受管面);合并后的第一次 dispatch 和把 ghcr 包设为 Public(一次,不可撤回)写在 Verification 里。

## What changes

- `.github/workflows/framework-build-base.yml` (new). Three triggers, none per commit:
  - `workflow_dispatch` with `sha` (a full 40-hex commit on `main`) and an optional `rebuild` boolean;
  - `repository_dispatch`, event type `framework-build-base`, with `client_payload.sha`: the hook a downstream pin move can call later;
  - `pull_request` touching the workflow or `docker/framework-build-base/**`: the dry run. Job `verify` builds the PR's base commit with the PR's Dockerfile, loads it into the runner, looks inside, and pushes nothing. Its permissions are `contents: read` only.
- Job `publish` (the only job with `packages: write`) runs only on a dispatch from `main` or a `repository_dispatch`. It:
  1. refuses a requested commit that is not 40-hex lowercase, or not on `main` (the compare API must answer `ahead` or `identical`);
  2. reads the registry: a tag that already exists reports its digest and builds nothing, unless `rebuild: true`;
  3. checks out the image definition from this run's `main` and the requested commit as the build context, both with `persist-credentials: false`;
  4. builds `linux/amd64` and pushes `ghcr.io/objectstack-ai/framework-build-base:SHA` (no provenance or SBOM manifests, so the tag is one plain image manifest);
  5. logs out of ghcr.io and pulls the pushed digest anonymously, then runs `check-image.sh` on it;
  6. writes the commit, tag, digest, build wall seconds, the anonymous-read outcome and the image readings to the job summary, with a ready `FROM ...:SHA@DIGEST` line.
- `docker/framework-build-base/Dockerfile` (new). The framework stage of cloud's `apps/cloud`, `apps/objectos` and `apps/objectos-ee` Dockerfiles at cloud `ac69aac`, with the same arguments: `node:22-slim`, `python3 make g++ ca-certificates git`, `CI=true`, `OS_SKIP_DTS=1`, corepack `pnpm@10.31.0`, `PNPM_HOME=/pnpm`, store `/pnpm/store` in a cache mount, the in-tree authorable-surface anchor assert, `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile --prefer-offline --prod=false` against registry.npmjs.org, `turbo run build --filter='!@objectstack/docs' --filter='!./ui/**' --concurrency=1` at a 12 GB heap, then the typed Console `turbo run build:dist --filter=@objectstack/console --concurrency=1` with `VITE_APP_VERSION` = first 8 hex of the commit, then `rm -rf ui`. The tree lands at `/repo/objectstack`, the path cloud's `link:` dependencies resolve to.
- `docker/framework-build-base/Dockerfile.dockerignore` (new): `.git`, `node_modules`, `.pnpm-store`, `.turbo`, the artifact-only list the three cloud ignore files share.
- `docker/framework-build-base/check-image.sh` (new): runs inside the image with no network and fails when there is a `.git` anywhere under `/repo`, the workspace is not pnpm-installed, `spec` or `core` has no `dist`, the Console `index.html` is missing, `ui/` is still there, no Console asset carries the commit's 8-hex build identity, or `OS_SKIP_DTS` is not `1`. It prints node and pnpm versions, counts, and the image size.

## Why

Cloud pins the framework by commit, usually between releases, and links it as a workspace by path, so the existing runtime image (`ghcr.io/objectstack-ai/objectstack`, an npm install of a released CLI) cannot serve it. Each of cloud's three image builds therefore installs and builds the whole framework and the Console itself, cold on every pin move or cache eviction, in a private repository's billed minutes. This image does that once per commit in this public repository. Cloud card 11b (objectstack-ai/cloud#3792, blocked on this card) switches the three Dockerfiles to start `FROM` it.

## Tests

- Local gates derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` at `b91dc73d` for this change set: 35 commands, all exit 0 (closing-keyword parity, self-test wiring, step collectors, workflow step-name quoting, workflow status functions, required contexts, stall-guard budget and headroom, pnpm acquisition, node version, NUL bytes and the rest). `check:pm-dispatch-gates` runs separately; its result is in the card's report.
- `bash -n` on `check-image.sh`; the workflow parses as YAML with jobs `verify`, `publish`.
- The real build is this PR's own `verify` run (the `pull_request` trigger matches this PR's paths). Its build wall and image readings are in that run's job summary and in the card's report.

## Acceptance notes

- **One Console for all three downstream images.** The self-managed image built its Console with three `VITE_SENTRY_*` levers (empty DSN, kill switch off, PII default off); the other two did not. This image builds with the levers on. On this tree the Console no longer reads any of the three (client error reporting is runtime configuration, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/observability/sentry.ts`), so the levers change no behaviour; they stay so a build-time DSN can never ship silently in the customer artefact.
- **Registry.** cloud's `apps/cloud` and `apps/objectos` builders set `npm_config_registry` and `COREPACK_NPM_REGISTRY` to npmmirror as image ENV, and `apps/objectos` installs the framework from it. This image installs from registry.npmjs.org and sets no registry ENV. The lockfile pins integrity, so the installed tree is the same; a downstream stage that wants the mirror for its own install sets it after `FROM`.
- **`.gitignore`.** Two of the three cloud ignore files also exclude `**/.gitignore`; the self-managed one does not, and the cloud file records that the line moves no turbo hash. This image keeps `.gitignore`, as the self-managed image does.
- **Trust.** `publish`'s `if:` (main, or a repository_dispatch) is the policy, not a security boundary: anyone who can push a branch could edit it there. The commit check is what keeps a branch head or a fork's pull ref out of a published image.
- **Dispatching it.** AGENTS.md Prime Directive 15 reserves dispatching "any other publish-capable workflow" to the maintainer, and the fleet relay's `workflow_dispatch` op allows only closed, fixed inputs per file, so it could not carry a commit anyway. The first dispatch is the maintainer's click unless a ruling says otherwise. A `workflow_dispatch` trigger also only exists for this file once it is on `main`, so nothing could be dispatched from this branch.
- **Budget.** `timeout-minutes: 60` on both jobs, with no reading of this workflow on record yet; the same stage runs about 20 minutes cold inside cloud's image builds on the same runner class. The reading from this PR's `verify` run should replace the note.

## Verification

- This PR's `Framework Build Base Image / Build framework build base (dry run, no push)` check: job summary shows the build wall and the readings.
- After merge: Actions, Framework Build Base Image, Run workflow on `main` with a commit (for example cloud's current `.objectstack-sha`, `98583cd692c6a67891617529d2f7aec4963859b8`). The summary prints the digest. Then, logged out: `docker pull ghcr.io/objectstack-ai/framework-build-base:SHA` succeeds once the package is Public.
- A digest is obtained from that run's summary, or at any time with `docker buildx imagetools inspect ghcr.io/objectstack-ai/framework-build-base:SHA`, or by dispatching the same commit again (an existing tag reports its digest and builds nothing).
